subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext` permanently expose a current-session `resetSession(reason?)` method for successful after-compaction hooks across core and bundled harnesses?
rationale: This adds a shipped plugin contract and lifecycle authority spanning core, Codex, and Copilot; correctness fixes alone cannot decide whether that public surface is desired.

options.title: Approve the narrow hook API
options.body: Keep the after-compaction-only, current-session contract after the state defects are fixed, the unrelated abort behavior is split, and real lifecycle proof is supplied.

options.title: Keep reset owner-specific
options.body: Remove the generic hook API and expose reset behavior only through the owning memory or context plugin contract.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Hold the PR until a focused plugin API proposal defines lifecycle ownership, success semantics, compatibility, and harness behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Keep the after-compaction-only, current-session contract after the state defects are fixed, the unrelated abort behavior is split, and real lifecycle proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history signal connects this person to the compaction/reset hook contract being extended.
